thread:
asha: Heads-up — Nebula Labs pilot flagged a churn signal. After enabling RBAC + cost alerts, their team reports unexpected token spend and dropped activation. They mentioned downgrading the pilot or ending early. Need a short, actionable save plan we can run this week. Anyone on a quick play?

marta: On it. Can we get a 7-day breakdown of their token burn and top paths? @cs-bot can you surface the dashboard and any recent support tickets?

cs-bot: Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/NEBULA-42 — 7d burn spike at 3x baseline, bulk of tokens from "batch-eval" route. Open ticket #8792 from their infra lead re: RBAC noise.

ryan: Thanks. Proposed micro-save (fast, low-legal friction):
1) Offer a 3-week pilot extension.
2) Apply a hard usage cap for the pilot and cover overage for first two weeks.
3) Reconfigure default batch size server-side to reduce token usage (we can roll a safe config now).
4) Offer a short enablement session to walk through RBAC and cost controls.

samira: I can run the enablement session — 30min demo + checklist. Draft message to customer:```
Hi Clara — thanks for the call today. We can extend your pilot 3 weeks and put a temporary usage cap on the account to prevent surprise spend. We’ll also push a safe batch config to reduce token consumption and schedule a 30-min walkthrough on RBAC/cost controls. Would Thursday 10am PT work?
Best, Samira (Redwood CSM)
```

marta: +1. Add a clear downgrade-safe fallback: if they still want to cut scope, map features to tiers and propose a temporary feature toggle that removes heavy batch paths but preserves core evaluation flow.

ryan: Action items I can do today:
- push batch-size rollback to prod feature toggle (ops: deploy-safe)
- add usage cap at account level and enable billing hold for overage reimbursement
- prepare quick rollback plan if performance/regression appears

asha: Assigning: @ryan (ops + cap) due: 4pm PT, @samira (enablement + outreach) due: EOD, @marta (handbook: downgrade-fallback mapping + messaging) due: tomorrow morning. Samira, please paste the final outreach copy here before sending.

samira: Will do. I'll CC account exec to soften the ask. Draft updated message below (short):```
Hi Clara — quick follow-up: we can extend your pilot 3 weeks and put a hard usage cap in place so there are no surprise charges. We’ll also adjust batch settings on our side and run a 30-min session to walk RBAC + cost controls. If that works I’ll schedule the call and confirm the cap level.
```

marta: I also propose a small concession if they commit to a paid pilot after the extension: 25% off the first monthly commit or one month free of Dedicated. Use sparingly but effective for strategic proofs.

asha: That concession needs sales thumbs-up — @ryan can you ping AE? I'll loop the AE and legal if they accept. If approved, include in the outreach as an optional line.

ryan: Pinged AE in DM. AE is fine with a one-month credit if they convert to a paid pilot within 30 days of extension end.

asha: Cool. Samira — send outreach by 3:45pm PT. Update this thread when sent and paste the exact copy. After outreach, ticket #8792 gets a "save-plan" tag and assign to CSM for tracking. I'll draft a short internal play note after close.

samira: Sent at 15:42 PT. Copy pasted into ticket and slack DM to Clara. Will add meeting link once she confirms.

asha: Thanks team — keep updates short here. If we get a thumbs-down, we move to the downgrade-fallback (marta to own mapping) and schedule a churn prevention retro. :thumbsup:
